title.zh: Chainlink launches new version of its crypto bridge tech 'CCIP' to give apps more control over their security
title.en: Chainlink launches new version of its crypto bridge tech 'CCIP' to give apps more control over their security

current_state.zh: Chainlink has released a new version of its Cross-Chain Interoperability Protocol (CCIP) that allows applications to add customizable security checks and configurations, aimed at preventing the class of bridge vulnerabilities that led to a $292 million hack.
current_state.en: Chainlink has released a new version of its Cross-Chain Interoperability Protocol (CCIP) that allows applications to add customizable security checks and configurations, aimed at preventing the class of bridge vulnerabilities that led to a $292 million hack.
